intuition: Push targets the leftmost non-full stack, while pop targets the rightmost non-empty stack.

brute_force.approach: Scan all stacks from the appropriate end for each push or pop.

optimal.approach: Use min- and max-heaps of candidate stack indices with lazy removal of stale candidates.

edge_cases: Empty trailing stacks do not affect the rightmost pop.
Popping from an empty stack index returns -1.
